review.summary: UI slice of 2.1.1 (ActionGrid, Foot, Kpis, LogPeek, Activity, logLook, Game, Ending, ClainkUi, director.js, player.js), reviewed read-only and probed on the built files with Playwright; tracked files are untouched and all scratch is under test-results/review/ui/. The new run-ending confirmation is tight: I could not get a marked press through by any route, No changes nothing, and Yes is exactly the rules' move. The touch fix, the live hint bar, the New-run hold, the 80 ms cue delay and onModal(id, params) all behave as described. The allowed checks pass (actions 104/104, phone 55/55, engine 120/120, audio 15/15, both lints clean). I found two regressions against 2.1 that neither gate catches, plus two places where the report and changelog claim more than the build does. (1) On a phone, the notice that used to tell a clAInk run's result is dropped whenever any 48px of the workspace is on the screen; in the usual position (End week mid-screen, Run agents just below) the report lands below the fold, so the result is shown nowhere. (2) Pressing End week while a report is still playing (about 2 s after Run agents, which is free and so a natural last press) leaves the workspace scrolled away from Run agents for the next week, because the return-to-top is skipped while the follow is on. (3) The rent "certain to end the run" claim is not certain when a late-stage deal is on the board: the run goes on in 7.8% to 13.1% of such Fridays. (4) The fatal Hail Mary is not marked, though the report says it is.
checked_ok: Fatal-press confirmation cannot be bypassed (p3-fatal-routes.cjs on dist/index.html, 48/48): number keys 1, 8, -, =; the H key; Enter and Space on a focused card; a double click; bursts such as 1, Enter, 1, Enter, 1, Space; two keydowns or three clicks dispatched in one task; taps, a second tap in place and two taps with no pause in a 390x844 touch context (Prospect blitz, Hail Mary, conference, quad shot). The stored run stayed byte-identical after No, Enter (focus is on No) and Escape.

Yes does exactly the move: from a seeded v5 envelope the page's stored state equals step() run in Node from the same seed (mechanical fields, dice position and log tags; deal ids excluded), with the right ending dialog, for Prospect blitz, Internal politics, conference by cash and by stress, quad shot by cash and by stress, and the Hail Mary.

Touch first tap (p4-touch-tap.cjs, 390x664): taps at 15%, 50% and 85% of End week's height all end the week on rc. The 2.1 file loses the 15% tap (hint bar grows 54 to 73px, week stays 2), so the phone gate's new check does discriminate. The Hail Mary's first tap opens its question on rc and nothing on 2.1.

Blocked controls on touch still say why: Hail Mary with no late deal, too little energy or no slots; Close deals short of energy; Proposals with nothing to gain; Recharge already used. The reason is in the hint bar, or in the bottom notice when the bar is off the screen; the run is unchanged each time.

Desktop hint bar (p7-hints.cjs): a number key on an off action focuses its card and shows the reason while the pointer rests on another card; Tab moves the hint with the focus; End week's hint is re-read after the week turns (the rent line is gone in week 6); after a confirmation answered No with the mouse the focused card's hint comes back, as 2.1's own confirmations did. No hint for a wrong control seen.

The '+N' chip hint, which the actions gate's section 8 does not hover, fits the fixed two-line bar with the fullest fixture (board-24-deals, 5 folded chips) at 1025x768, 1100x700, 1280x720, 1366x657 and 1440x900.

Follow-scroll otherwise sound (p9-follow-after.cjs, 1280x720): it follows only during the report; afterwards a wheel to the top stays at 0 through an action by key, an action by click and minimize plus expand; a reload starts at 0. The title bar is sticky, so the card-top arithmetic does not drift, and the no-dependency effect returns at once when not following. New run and Load remount the dock (keyed on runId and epoch).

Actions gate section 9 'in sight' check is discriminating and was not flaky in my samples: it fails 8/8 on the 2.1 file and passes 20/20 random-seed runs and 24/24 seeded manager-ping runs at each of 1280x720 and 1366x768 on rc. Its outcome is rolled, though the file's header says nothing depends on a roll.

New-run hold, timed inside the page (p6b-hold.cjs): with reduced motion, presses 150, 500 and 650 ms after the ending opens are swallowed and presses at 760 and 1000 ms start a run; with full motion Skip has the focus and New run answers at 150 ms.
Reduced-motion endings by reload, six fixtures at 1366x657: each opens at scrollTop 0/0 with the announcer's line under the title, nothing in the top bar, and focus on New run.

player.js 80 ms cue delay: the boot screen with reduced motion clocks in, captions its line and leaves after about 2.1 s; stop() clears the pending timer and no page error occurs on an immediate skip. The only side effect seen is that a skip within 80 ms drops the boot line.

director.onModal(id, params): Game passes shown.params from the same render as shownId; ck:warning's {miracle} comes from clainkManager and is stored with the pending choice (queueChoice), so it survives a reload; a choice with no params still speaks as in 2.1.

Allowed checks run by me: node test/e2e/actions.cjs dist/index.html gives 104/104; node test/e2e/phone.cjs dist-test/index.html gives 55/55; engine unit tests 120/120; audio unit tests 15/15; lint-copy 0 violations; lint-css 0 findings. git status shows no tracked change.

findings.title: Phone: a clAInk run's result is shown nowhere on the screen when Run agents is tapped from the usual position
findings.where: src/ui/app/LogPeek.jsx lines 65-66 (told = onScreen(.claink-console:not(.is-mini)), i.e. any 48px of the workspace); QA report item 18; CHANGELOG 'Feedback', last bullet
findings.evidence: Probe test-results/review/ui/p5c-phone-natural.cjs, touch contexts, fixture ck-active-0-strikes, End week scrolled to the middle of the screen (what the phone gate does). Run agents is then wholly on screen just below it (top 484 to 622). On dist/index.html at 360x640, 390x664, 390x844 and 412x915, 12 of 12 runs: .peek never appeared and the result card (.claink-strike / .claink-clear) was never on the screen, not even partly; at 360x640 not even the report's first line was. Same steps on Tech_Sales_Trail_2.1.html, 8 of 8: the notice told the result, e.g. 'clAInk: 3 billable outcomes, 4.5M tokens, $0 closed. Strike 1/3 (Marketing Ops): 20 follow-ups. HyperLobster walked.' Threshold on 390x664 (p5-phone-run-notice.cjs): the card is off screen whenever the button's lower edge is in the bottom ~150px, and nothing of the report shows in the bottom ~70px. Pictures: phone-run-rc-1-at1500ms.png against phone-run-v21-1-at1500ms.png in the same folder. The player sees the button turn to 'Ran this week' and a strike box fill, not what the strike took. The phone gate passes 55/55 because item 18 has no check ('looked at').
findings.proposal: Decide by where the report lands, not by whether the workspace is in view: hold the run's lines until the report has had its say, then raise the notice unless the result card is on the screen. That also keeps the original aim of not announcing the strike early. Add a phone-gate check: End week centred, tap Run agents, the result must be on the screen in the workspace or in the notice.

findings.title: End week pressed while a clAInk report is still playing leaves the workspace scrolled away from Run agents for the next week
findings.where: src/ui/ClainkUi.jsx line 433 (the week-turn effect does nothing while follow.current is true) with lines 421-432; QA report item 20 ('returns to its top when the week turns')
findings.evidence: Probe test-results/review/ui/p2-endweek-during-report.cjs on dist/index.html, 1280x720, fixture ck-active-0-strikes. Click Run agents, press E 300 ms later: in the 6 of 8 runs where the week turned (2 to 3; the other two were stopped by the manager's dialog) the workspace ended at scrollTop 98 to 191 with .claink-deploy (enabled again, 'Run agents') and the strike boxes out of sight. Click on End week 1500 ms after: 4 of 4 turned weeks, scrollTop 174 to 273. Controls: End week 3.5 s after gives scrollTop 0 in 3 of 3; the 2.1 file gives 0 in 3 of 3. Picture endweek-during-report-1366x768.png (same folder): Week 3, the workspace shows last week's 'RUN 1 - OUTCOMES DELIVERED ... STRIKE 1 OF 3', and Run agents' lower edge (y 362) is above the title bar's (y 445). The window is 650 + (lines + 2) x 280 ms, about 1.8 to 2.6 s, and Run agents costs 0 energy and 0 slots, so it is a natural last press before End week. Actions gate section 9 presses End week only 4.3 s after the run, so it passes (104/104).
findings.proposal: Let the week turn end the follow: in the [s.week, s.runId] layout effect set follow.current = false and scrollTop = 0 unconditionally. Add a gate step that presses End week about 300 ms after Run agents and requires scrollTop 0 when the week turned.

findings.title: The rent warning is called certain but is not when a late-stage deal is on the board, and its hint drops the usual caveat
findings.where: src/ui/app/Kpis.jsx line 53 (cash card, KPI.rentBust); src/ui/app/Foot.jsx line 33 (HINT.endWeek, bust branch); src/game/selectors.js lines 67-72 (fridayPreview.bust); QA report item 4; CHANGELOG 'A Friday that is certain to end the run says so'
findings.evidence: week.js runs Friday's own close attempt (15%) before salaryAndBills, and its commission is paid first. test-results/review/ui/n1-rent-bust.cjs asks the rules in Node, 4,000 seeds per board, week 5, cash -$900 and -$1,200. The preview says bust in 4000/4000 every time. With no deals Collections ends all 4000. With one happy $40,000 deal at Closing the run went on in 312 (7.8%); with three happy late deals in 524 (13.1%). The page meanwhile says, with no caveat, 'Friday's rent would trigger Collections' on the cash card and 'rent -$1,600. That would leave -$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at -$1,500.' on End week (text from the actions gate's own output). The coffee-crash half of the claim is sound: nothing on a Friday lowers stress in such a week. The root is in selectors.js, outside my file list, so the engine reviewer may report it too.
findings.proposal: Either treat it as certain only when no late-stage deal could sign (lateDeals(s).length === 0) and otherwise keep a caveat such as 'unless a deal signs on Friday', or change 'certain' in the QA report and changelog to match what the rules do.

findings.title: A Hail Mary that is certain to end the run is not marked, though the report and changelog list it among the presses that are
findings.where: src/ui/app/Foot.jsx lines 132-133 (the Hail Mary button); QA report item 3; CHANGELOG 'What a press would buy', third bullet
findings.evidence: node test/e2e/tools/shot.cjs --state with one late deal at 1280x720, read with --eval: at 96 stress (fatalPress gives stress) and at 95 the button is identical, '<button type="button" class="btn" data-ui="hail">...Hail Mary</button>', same colour and border. The action cards in the fatal state read 'Ends the run' in the risk colour. Nothing gets through: the hint says so when pointed at and the confirmation always asks (p3-fatal-routes.cjs, B1 to B4 and the touch case). But on a touch screen nothing says it before the tap; QA section 4.11 covers the missing hint, not the missing mark.
findings.proposal: Give the button the risk tone and a screen-reader 'Ends the run' when hailWords(s) is fatal, or take the Hail Mary out of the sentence 'is marked' in the report and changelog.

verdicts.title: Phone: a clAInk run's result is shown nowhere on the screen when Run agents is tapped from the usual position
verdicts.why:
Reproduced with my own probe test-results/review/ui-check/g1-phone-run.cjs. Setup: touch contexts like the phone gate (isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 2), fixture ck-active-0-strikes, End week scrolled to the centre, a touchscreen tap on Run agents, then a sample every 100 ms for 4.8 s.
- RC (dist/index.html) at 360x640, 390x664 and 390x844: in 9 of 9 runs the result card (.claink-strike / .claink-clear) never entered the screen. It rested at y 759 to 985 on screens 640 to 844 tall, and .peek never appeared.
- RC at 412x915: 2 of 3 runs showed only the card's top 12 to 32 px; 1 of 3 showed nothing.
- 2.1 (Tech_Sales_Trail_2.1.html), same steps: the notice told the result in 12 of 12 runs, e.g. 'clAInk: 2 billable outcomes, 2.4M tokens, $0 closed. Strike 1/3 (Marketing Ops): 26 follow-ups. HyperLobster walked.'
- The page never scrolls on either build: scrollY stays put and the Activity log is at y 1100 or lower.
- Pictures g1-rc-390x664-at3600.png and g1-v21-390x664-at3600.png: on the RC the player sees only the strike box crossed ('1 down. Strike 3 revokes the seat…') and the caption 'Strike recorded.'. On 2.1 the notice reads 'Strike 1/3 (IT Security): Shared 2 deals ($27,000) with Scheisskorp.' Per the workspace card, that strike cost 2 deals ($27,000).
- With Run agents centred instead of End week (g1-phone-run-deploy-center.out), 390x844 and 412x915 show the card whole, but 360x640 and 390x664 show only its top.

Cause: LogPeek.jsx line 65 counts the workspace as telling the run when any 48 px of it are on screen, and Run agents itself qualifies, while the report lands below it. test/e2e/phone.cjs has no clAInk step at all (grep), so item 18 is held only by 'looked at'. 2.1's notice did cover the strike boxes about 2 s early, which is what item 18 meant to fix. 2.1.1 trades that for no result on screen, and neither §1 item 18 nor §4.6 says so.
verdicts.smallest_fix: In LogPeek.jsx, when the workspace is in view, set the run's lines aside instead of dropping them. Once the report has played (CK_WORK_MS + (lines+4) x CK_BEAT_MS), flush them unless .claink-console .claink-strike/.claink-clear is on the screen. Add a phone-gate check: at 390x664 with End week centred, tap Run agents; within about 4 s the result must be on the screen, in the workspace or in the notice. If that is too much for this pass, remove the `told` filter (back to 2.1 behaviour) and move item 18 to §4.6 as unresolved.

verdicts.title: End week pressed while a clAInk report is still playing leaves the workspace scrolled away from Run agents for the next week
verdicts.why:
Reproduced with test-results/review/ui-check/g2-endweek-during-report.cjs on dist/index.html, fixture ck-active-0-strikes.
- 1280x720, Run agents then the E key 300 ms later: 3 of 5 weeks turned; the other 2 were held by the manager's ck:warning dialog. In all 3 turned weeks the workspace ended at scrollTop 185, 224 and 244, which is its maximum each time. Run agents was enabled again ('Run agents 0 energy · 0 slots · billed Friday') but sat above the title bar's lower edge, out of sight. Under the title bar was last week's report ('Closed: $0', etc.).
- 1366x768, mouse click on End week 1.5 s after the run: 3 of 3 turned weeks ended at scrollTop 114 to 158 (the maximum), Run agents hidden. Picture g2-rc-1366x768-1500-click.png: Week 3, with last week's 'RUN 1 · OUTCOMES DELIVERED' and 'STRIKE 1 OF 3 · filed by IT Security' in view. The status line and Run agents are scrolled away, while End week's hint already previews an idle week.
- Controls: RC with E 4 s after the run gives scrollTop 0 and Run agents in sight, 3 of 3. 2.1 with E 300 ms after gives scrollTop 0, 2 of 2 turned weeks.

Cause: ClainkUi.jsx line 433 does nothing while follow.current is true. The follow effect keeps scrolling to the foot and then to the result card, and clears follow only when the report ends; nothing resets the scroll in the new week. This contradicts QA item 20 and the CHANGELOG line 'It returns to its top when the week turns'. Actions gate §9 presses End week only after 4.3 s plus dialogs, so it cannot catch this. Run agents is free, so a player who habitually presses it and then E meets this every week.
verdicts.smallest_fix: Change ClainkUi.jsx line 433 to: useLayoutEffect(()=>{ const el=ref.current; follow.current=false; if(el) el.scrollTop=0; },[s.week,s.runId]). It runs after the follow effect in the same commit, so later beats stop following. Add a step to actions gate §9: press End week about 300 ms after Run agents and require scrollTop 0 when the week turned.

verdicts.title: The rent warning is called certain but is not when a late-stage deal is on the board, and its hint drops the usual caveat
verdicts.why:
Reproduced in the rules with test-results/review/ui-check/g3-rent-bust.mjs: the engine from src/ via test/engine/lib/kit.mjs, week 5, the run's own seeded dice, seeds 1 to 4000 (results in g3-rent-bust.out).
- No deals, cash -900 or -1200: the preview says bust 4000/4000 and Collections ends 4000/4000.
- One happy $40,000 deal at stage 4: the preview says bust 4000/4000, but the run went on in 212 (5.3%), each time through a Friday signing.
- One neutral $21,000 deal at stage 3: the run went on in 123 (3.1%).
- Three happy late deals: the run went on in 394 (9.8%).
The reason is in week.js: the 15% Friday close (tryCloseSome, which pays 12% commission into cash) runs before salaryAndBills.

On the page, via shot.cjs on dist/index.html (week 5, cash -900, the $40,000 deal): the cash card reads 'Friday’s rent would trigger Collections' and End week reads 'Friday: salary +$1,000, rent −$1,600. That would leave −$1,500 cash. Collections ends the run at −$1,500.', with no caveat. 2.1 in the same state reads 'Collections at −$1,500 cash' and '…energy +15, stress −4. Friday events and collections may change this.'

QA item 4 and the CHANGELOG present this Friday as certain to end the run. Neither test reaches the case: the gate's §4 uses an empty board, and the engine test scripts the Friday close away ('when no Friday signing comes first'). Player impact is small: the state is rare, and the run still ends 90 to 97% of the time. But the page and the documents state a certainty the rules do not have. I did not re-check the coffee-crash half.
verdicts.smallest_fix: In selectors.js fridayPreview, call it bust only when even the best Friday signing could not save it, e.g. bust: cash + Math.round(lateDeals(s).reduce((t,d)=>t+d.value,0) * PAY.commission) <= CASH.repoAt. On an empty board this is the current test. Otherwise the cash card and hint fall back to 2.1's wording and its caveat. Add an engine case with a late deal. A code-free alternative is to say in QA item 4 and the changelog that the rent warning assumes no Friday signing.

verdicts.title: A Hail Mary that is certain to end the run is not marked, though the report and changelog list it among the presses that are
verdicts.why:
Reproduced with shot.cjs on dist/index.html, 1280x720, one late deal (pictures g4-*.png in test-results/review/ui-check/).
- At 96 stress (fatal) and 95 stress the Hail Mary is the same element, '<button type="button" class="btn" data-ui="hail">…Hail Mary</button>', with the same colour, border and background, and no aria-label or title.
- At 98 stress the Internal politics and Prospect blitz cards read 'Ends the run' in a 'seg risk' span, so the cards are marked.
- The player is still protected. Hovering the Hail Mary at 96 gives 'This adds at least 4 stress. That reaches 100 and ends the run.' A touch tap at 390x664 opens confirm:stress ('This reaches 100 stress and ends the run. Not now / Do it anyway').
- Actions gate §4 deliberately skips the mark check for the Hail Mary (seen = id === "hail" ? null).

QA §1 item 3 and the CHANGELOG ('What a press would buy', third bullet) list the Hail Mary among presses that are 'marked `Ends the run`', which is false for it. The release notes say 'the card reads', which is accurate. This is a false statement in the documents, not a player-facing defect; 2.1 had no marks at all.
verdicts.smallest_fix: Fix the wording in QA item 3 and the CHANGELOG bullet: the action cards are marked `Ends the run`; the Hail Mary says so in its hint and asks first. Alternatively, mark the button: give it the risk tone and an sr-only 'Ends the run' when hailWords(s) is fatal.
